description: Height histograms of the zero-threshold diagnostic .mdpeak of every set diagnosed before 2026-10-06, each Height rounded down to a multiple of quantum. Rounding down to a multiple of q keeps the count at or above every multiple of q, so the estimator chooses on these exactly as on the original heights (checked for every set when this file was written). before is Interactive 0.5.24 (39842ef); after is the fallback rule of 0.5.28. Target 3000-6000.
